title: Set up the equation
text: Salt comes in at $$0.1\times2=0.2$$ kg per minute and leaves at $$\frac{2y}{100}=\frac{y}{50}$$ kg per minute. So $$y'=0.2-\frac{y}{50}$$, with $$y(0)=1$$.

title: Separate and solve
text: Rewrite as $$y'=\frac{10-y}{50}$$ and separate: $$\frac{dy}{10-y}=\frac{dt}{50}$$. Integrating gives $$10-y=A e^{\left(-\frac{t}{50}\right)}$$, and $$y(0)=1$$ gives $$A=9$$. So $$y=10-9e^{\left(-\frac{t}{50}\right)}$$.
